messages:
Aisha: Morning handoff — I'm primary for next 12h. Quick summary: we had a partial 503 spike in eu-west between 03:12–03:45 UTC that affected ~12% of requests to /v1/generate. PagerDuty fired twice, we triaged and mitigated.

Ken: Noted. Who's secondary? 

Aisha: Carlos is secondary for the shift. @Carlos +1? :wave:

Carlos: here. Confirmed. What was root cause analysis so far?

Aisha: Short version: a batcher goroutine leak + sudden embed autoscaler spin-up caused head-of-line latencies upstream, backlog pushed to the routing layer, relays returned 503s for a subset of tokens. Mitigation steps we ran:
- scaled down the offending batcher (hotfix patch) via deploy bot
- applied temporary rate-limit on long-seq routes
- bumped routing fallback to regional fallback for eu-west

inc-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2387 — EU-WEST 503 spike. Severity: P2. Link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-2387

Ken: Thanks. Any customer impact? SLAs hit?

Aisha: Affected ~200k requests over 30 minutes. No long-term data loss. Two enterprise customers (org-778, org-112) reported degraded UX; SLOs were briefly degraded but recovered within 20m. CS already notified.

Carlos: Runbook pointers I used: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/batcher-leaks and https://confluence.redwood/playbooks/relays-fallback. Also PR for hotfix: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8245

Ken: Are there coverage gaps we need to call out for the next shift?

Aisha: Yes — embedding autoscaler metrics don't surface pod churn in the default dashboard. Action item: add churn metric to eu dashboards. Also need a canary for batcher goroutine memory regressions.

Carlos: I'll own the dashboard change. Aisha please add the canary ticket.

Aisha: Created ticket TKT-4321 and assigned to eng-infra. Link: https://tickets/redwood/TKT-4321

Ken: Any manual steps for the next on-call if it reoccurs?

Aisha: Short checklist (paste into your playbook):
```
1) Check inc-bot for INC-2026-2387
2) Run: ./scripts/list-hot-batchers --region eu-west
3) If batcher leak present: k deploy hotfix v8245
4) Apply rate-limit: curl -X POST https://ops-api/ratelimit -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","limit":50}'
5) If >10% 503s after 10m -> escalate to eng-runtime and set regional fallback to global
```

Ken: Solid. Anything outstanding for this shift?

Carlos: CS follow-ups, add dashboards, canary ticket. I'll begin dashboard work now and post status.

Aisha: I'll stay as primary for 1 more hour to handover to Ken at 10:00 UTC. Handing off monitoring and Pg logs location: /var/log/relays/eu-west/*.log

Ken: i'll take over at 10:00 UTC. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Aisha: :thumbsup: closing loop here — will update if anything else shows up.
